poster_title: A Comprehensive Survey of Reward Models: Taxonomy, Applications, Challenges, and Future
authors: Jialun Zhong, Wei Shen, Yanzeng Li, Songyang Gao, Hua Lu, Yicheng Chen, Yang Zhang, Wei Zhou, Jinjie Gu, Lei Zou

content: First comprehensive survey on Reward Models (RMs) in the Large Language Models (LLMs) era.
Covers taxonomy, applications, challenges, and future directions.
Aims to assist beginners and guide future research.
LLMs have driven advancements in various tasks.
Alignment techniques reduce human involvement in the alignment process.
RMs trained on human preferences provide reward signals for reinforcement learning.
Previous surveys lack systematic organization of RMs.
Need for a comprehensive introduction to RMs for beginners and future research.
Presents a taxonomy of RMs: preference collection, reward modeling, and usage.
Reviews related works and introduces an elaborate taxonomy.
Identifies key areas of research and provides a structured taxonomy for RMs.
Highlights the importance of improving preference collection efficiency and quality.
Discusses integration of AI and human preferences in reward modeling.
Provides a comprehensive overview of RMs, including taxonomy, applications, and challenges.
Aims to assist beginners in understanding RMs and guide future research.
